scope: Additive Giant Arrow L1-18 audit of current Air Defense multiplier, four published damage corrections and piercing projectile timing.
game_version: Official 2023-12 launch, 2024-02 travel correction and 2026-05 balance/update; claimed client build 18.600.3 for dated Hero bonus table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Giant Arrow is Common active Archer Queen Equipment unlocked by Blacksmith level 2.
Its arrow crosses the enemy village and the Equipment increases Queen DPS and HP.
sources.limitations: No projectile speed, direction, collision width, first impact tick or per-level damage is published.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: The Giant Arrow travel distance was increased to cross the entire village.
sources.limitations: Distance in tiles and its effect on edge collision or the exact projectile stop point are not given.

sources.title: State of Gameplay - Part 2
facts: The official table changes Extra Damage vs Air Defense from 1x to 2x for all L1-18.
The published damage changes are L9 1200 to 1100, L12 1500 to 1200, L15 1750 to 1350 and L18 2000 to 1500.
sources.limitations: The table does not publish the other 14 post-balance damage values, projectile timing or how overlapping targets are hit.

sources.title: May Update
facts: The mandatory May update points to the announced Giant Arrow balance changes.
sources.limitations: The release note does not repeat the complete level table or attest that no later balance change occurred.

sources.title: Giant Arrow — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The published L1-18 Queen HP, DPS and ore-cost table matches the pinned payload, including L18 HP 581 and DPS 132.
sources.limitations: The public table omits projectile damage, Air Defense multiplier and projectile collision/timing.

sources.title: Pinned Giant Arrow Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The payload retains 18 per-level projectileDamage fields, Queen HP and DPS bonuses, and a one-tile damageRadius label.
sources.limitations: The raw projectile damage at L9, L12, L15 and L18 predates the official 2026 correction; radius semantics and current values at the other levels remain unverified.

official_2026_air_defense_damage_multipl.note: All L1-18; retained as sourced catalogue metadata until the complete projectile Core contract exists.

official_2026_projectile_damage_by_level.note: Only four published new values; the pinned source_fields.stats at those levels remain identifiable historical raw observations.

observations.note: Historical pinned sequence, not a verified 2026 current sequence.
Only source-explicit post-May rows; no interpolation to other levels or undocumented damage rounding.

derivations.result: Expose four official post-May damage values as sparse catalogue metadata
derivations.method: Copy only the four NEW VALUE cells from Supercell's published balance table; compare the CURRENT VALUE cells with the SHA-pinned payload.

derivations.result: Expose the official 2x multiplier as catalogue metadata
derivations.method: Copy the all-level Air Defense row; do not infer which geometric hits qualify or damage-order rounding.

derivations.result: Retain per-level Queen HP and DPS as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check dated claimed-build table against SHA-pinned normalized fields; stat stacking order is not inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the pinned L9, L12, L15 or L18 projectile damage as current
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell explicitly changed those four values in May 2026.

rejected_inferences.rule: Interpolate or hold constant the four published new damage values for adjacent levels
rejected_inferences.reason: The other 14 post-balance values are not published in the checked sources.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the one-tile label as a one-tile-wide line segment or projectile hitbox
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw radius field does not define center-line distance, target footprint overlap or edge inclusion.

rejected_inferences.rule: Fire toward the Queen's current target, her facing, or a user-selected direction
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked primary source specifies the direction selection rule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply every pierced hit at the activation tick or in entity-ID order along the line
rejected_inferences.reason: Projectile speed, impact sequence, simultaneous-hit phase and target-loss behavior are undocumented.

items: post-May base damage at the 14 unlisted levels and later balance continuity
direction selection, launch origin, target eligibility and Hero orientation
projectile speed, travel length and first/last impact tick
line width, Building footprint overlap, air/ground collision and edge inclusion
Air Defense double-damage staging and integer rounding
piercing hit order, destroyed target, trap, Wall and Hero interaction
Queen HP/DPS bonus stacking and simultaneous Equipment activation
Viewer line and arrow art/rights, snapshot, replay and RL command contract

conclusion: Giant Arrow L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Supercell establishes the all-level Air Defense multiplier and four post-May damage values, while current values for 14 levels and deterministic projectile geometry/tick order are missing.
